# Department of Defense total nominal on-budget and off-budget outlays
# FY 2011 to FY 2020 (in millions of dollars)
outlays = {
    2011: 678077,
    2012: 650869,
    2013: 607801,
    2014: 578013,
    2015: 562506,
    2016: 565365,
    2017: 568905,
    2018: 600705,
    2019: 653979,
    2020: 690420
}

# Extract values and sort them
values = sorted(outlays.values())
print("Sorted values:")
for i, v in enumerate(values, 1):
    print(f"  {i}. {v}")

# Calculate the 85th Hazen Percentile
# Hazen plotting position formula: P = (i - 0.5) / n
# For the 85th percentile: i = 0.85 * (n + 0.5)
n = len(values)
print(f"\nNumber of data points: {n}")

# Calculate the position
position = 0.85 * (n + 0.5)
print(f"Position for 85th percentile: {position}")

# Interpolate to find the value at this position
lower_idx = int(position - 1)  # 0-based index
upper_idx = lower_idx + 1
fraction = position - 1 - lower_idx

print(f"Lower index (0-based): {lower_idx}, Upper index: {upper_idx}")
print(f"Fraction: {fraction}")

lower_value = values[lower_idx]
upper_value = values[upper_idx]
print(f"Lower value: {lower_value}, Upper value: {upper_value}")

# Linear interpolation
result = lower_value + fraction * (upper_value - lower_value)
print(f"\n85th Hazen Percentile: {result}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredths: {round(result, 2)}")
EOF
